name: Yunquera de Henares (Spain)
description: Red field with a diagonal band of yellow and green from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Yunquera de Henares (a tower on red and a tree on green).
history: The arms of Yunquera de Henares were published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha on 12 May 1995 and the flag was approved on 10 November 2006; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, red, with a yellow and green diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, and the municipal arms at the centre.
